headline: insuperabilehart jumps from 73rd to 38th on ARC-2

sections.text: insuperabilehart gained 18.75 points to reach 59.17, rising from 73rd to 38th on the public ARC-AGI-2 board.
The rise moves insuperabilehart into the upper tier of the ARC-2 chase.
